priority_labels.required_scope: Only newly generated tests and tests intended for risk-based/selective execution need priority labels.
priority_labels.assessment: The current E2E expansion is labeled [P0]/[P1], and generated Rust risk tests use priority doc markers. Missing labels on unchanged legacy tests are not a maintainability violation. If CI must select Rust tests by priority, doc comments alone are not executable tags and a supported filtering convention would be needed.

recommendations: Refactor the 101-line Windows boundary mutation test without splitting its behavioral intent across unrelated files.
Centralize repeated E2E demo-page navigation/list lookup in one focused helper.
Keep priority labels mandatory for newly generated or risk-selectable tests; do not require retroactive labels on every legacy test solely for maintainability.
summary: Maintainability is good overall: 2 violations (1 HIGH, 1 LOW). Test-case boundaries, not containing Rust source-file lengths, were used for the >100-line rule.
